Flatpickr 4.6.13
https://github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr/releases/tag/v4.6.13
Files: dist/flatpickr.min.js, dist/flatpickr.min.css

Arabic locale (added for the ar site build):
  File:   l10n/ar.js
  Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flatpickr@4.6.13/dist/l10n/ar.js
          (github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr v4.6.13, dist/l10n/ar.js)
  Unmodified. It is a UMD bundle that registers window.flatpickr.l10ns.ar, so it
  must load after flatpickr.min.js. js/datepicker.js selects it and overrides
  firstDayOfWeek to 0 (Sunday), which is the working week in Saudi Arabia and
  matches the weekday numbering guide availability uses in inc/data.php.
